query.sql:
-- Log lines (stdout) and warnings (stderr) for 30 seconds.
for i = 1, 30 do
  if i % 7 == 0 then
    io.stderr:write(("disk %d%% full\n"):format(80 + i % 20))
  else
    io.write(("job %d done in %d ms\n"):format(i, math.random(5, 90)))
  end
  io.stdout:flush()
  vim.uv.sleep(1000)
end

show.title: stdout and stderr of a script

query.sql:
-- Items separated by "|": the environment, stdin and the directory; exit code 2.
io.write("env=" .. os.getenv("GREETING") .. "|")
io.write("stdin=" .. io.read("*a") .. "|")
io.write("cwd=" .. vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.uv.cwd(), ":t") .. "|")
os.exit(2)
